narration.full_text: In this section, we'll embark on an exciting journey into the world of trigonometry. Our main goal is to help you master trigonometric ratios, which are fundamental to understanding angles and triangles. You'll learn the core definitions of sine, cosine, and tangent, and how they relate to the sides of a right-angled triangle. We'll also cover their reciprocal counterparts: cosecant, secant, and cotangent. By the end, you'll be able to confidently apply these ratios to solve various problems involving right triangles and even evaluate trigonometric expressions and verify identities. Get ready to build a strong foundation in trigonometry!
